title: inventory/applications.json
description: The intended application model, copied from the ServiceNow CMDB (cmdb_ci_service, cmdb_ci_appl, cmdb_ci_server, cmdb_rel_ci) by the Application Map. applications[].name is the application: spelling and must equal the Grafana service label. The Relationship agent turns service / hosts[] / depends_on[] into intended depends_on edges and compares hosts[] against observed container rows. Nothing here is measured.

keys.description: application:<name> per row; service:<service> per registry-matched service; device:<host> per prod.json-matched host.

next_action.description: none | Run the services registry: <service_ci> | Add to prod.json: <host>

source_updated_at.description: Newest sys_updated_on across the four queries. Equal to the prior file's -> no write. The compiler uses updated_at as its watermark.

marker_ref.description: Catalog path the scoping marker was read from. The marker itself is not stored here.

registered.description: true when the name matched inventory/services.json services[].name or an alias.

device.description: inventory/prod.json devices[].name this server matched case-insensitively, in prod.json spelling. Null when not in inventory.

relations_ignored.description: cmdb_rel_ci rows whose type was not Depends on::Used by or Runs on::Runs.

name.description: cmdb_ci_appl.name as written. The application: spelling. Must equal the Grafana service label on the probe and the container.

service_ci.description: Name of the cmdb_ci_service that Depends on this tier, as written in the CMDB.

service.description: The registry services[].name that service_ci matched (name or alias, case-insensitive). Null when no registry row matched. Only this becomes a service: key.

hosts.description: Runs on::Runs children that are inventory/prod.json devices, in prod.json spelling, sorted.

hosts_unmapped.description: Runs on::Runs children not in prod.json. Text only; no key, no edge.

depends_on.description: Depends on::Used by children that are other applications[] rows, by name, sorted.
